promptTranslations.en:
Character Identity:
A fictional 30-year-old adult Japanese woman. A cheerful bakery café manager with a sophisticated, playful influencer-style presence. A small, soft, roundish oval face, gently plump cheeks, and a rounded chin. Large, expressive dark brown double-lidded eyes, midway between almond and round, with outer corners dipping very slightly. Neatly groomed soft arched eyebrows, a natural straight nose with a slightly rounded tip, and soft, full lips that naturally curve upward at the corners. Light warm-neutral Japanese skin with realistic pores, light natural redness, faint freckles across the bridge of the nose, and subtle asymmetry preserved. Exactly one tiny mole beneath the outer corner of her anatomical left eye. Her signature smile is a toothy, bright, playful grin revealing dimples on both cheeks. Hair is a shoulder-length, smooth straight layered bob. The part is slightly off-center, with only the ends curling naturally inward. The top surface, roots, crown, parting line, bangs, and upper hair framing the face are a uniform, glossy black to dark charcoal. A cool smoky gray to graphite silver inner accent color exists only beneath that dark surface layer, visible solely where tucked behind the ears and at the lower inner ends. No center split, no half-and-half color split, no center band, no gray roots or crown, no highlights around the face, no gradients, and no full-head gray. Modern influencer makeup features well-defined eyelashes, understated taupe eyeliner, and rose-beige lips, without smoothing the skin like plastic. Thin round black metal or gunmetal glasses are an optional signature accessory. Maintain the fictional adult facial features, face shape, freckles, left/right placement of the mole, dimples, black surface hair, inner accent placement, hair length, and adult age appearance specified here, without resembling any identifiable real person.

Body Consistency:
Height approximately 166 cm. Long legs and a confident posture. A healthy, lightly toned adult hourglass figure. Breasts are naturally full with a realistic base width proportionate to the ribcage, forward volume, and soft weight affected by gravity. The waist is tapered yet realistic, and the hips and buttocks are moderately plump with slightly fuller curves, connecting naturally from the pelvis to the thighs. Maintain height, ribcage, waist, pelvis, hip volume, and limb proportions even when the viewing angle changes. Uses ordinary opaque clothing and natural fabric tension. No lifting push-up corrections, deep cleavage, padding, extreme corseting, implant-like spherical shapes, impossibly tiny waists, exaggerated hips, or BBL-style contours.

Setting/Scene:
09:30. In the passenger seat of a parked car. In the middle of talking to a friend while handing them a drink.

Location and Background:
A car parked near home. Front passenger seat, car seat, drink holder.

Outfit:
A thin, opaque charcoal form-fitting sleeveless top, a light black ankle-length long skirt, and black flat sandals. Thin black-rimmed round glasses, thin silver hoops, and a small black shoulder bag.

Pose and Action:
Sitting in the passenger seat, extending a lidded drink toward the center console with her right hand, while her left hand rests on a small tote bag in her lap. Feet on the floor mat. Expression and head orientation: Zero lateral head tilt. Face turned 35 degrees toward the friend in the driver's seat. Eyebrows slightly raised, lips parted slightly mid-sentence. An inquiring, lively expression without forcing a smile.

Composition and Framing:
Taken with a friend's smartphone from the driver's seat of the parked car. Approximately 0.9 m away, height 1.2 m, standard 1x lens. Frame completely from head to knees, fully including both hands and the cup.
Output a single, unsplit image with a final size of 1086×1448 px and a 3:4 aspect ratio.

Lighting and Atmosphere:
Soft daylight through the car window.

Photographic Texture:
Render a minimally processed single HEIC photo as if taken with the default camera app on an ordinary smartphone. Do not confuse character, body, and hair geometry with surface finish. Follow a single camera-specified AF plane; do not re-light, denoise, or sharpen only a distant face. Details soften continuously with distance. Within the recognizable range of the face, maintain multiple broad tonal variations simultaneously—such as warm tones on one cheek, uneven shine in the T-zone, differing under-eye tones between left and right, and slight redness on the nose—without drawing visible pores on a distant face. On close, resolvable skin, preserve non-repeating low-contrast color variations, redness from pressure, wrinkle shadows, and sparse differences in pores. Makeup should look like actual pigments with slightly uneven edges; lips and teeth should retain normal color distinctions. Maintain uneven exposure and white balance, unlifted shadows, a few stray hairs, off-center framing, shadow noise, subtle sharpening near the AF point, and HEIC compression artifacts. Make it look like an unedited snapshot straight from a personal camera roll.

Mandatory Requirements:
Output exactly one unsplit smartphone photo of an adult female meeting all scene specifications. Fulfill both the scene pass criteria and the quality criteria for a natural smartphone photo.

One fictional 30-year-old adult female. The friend and the photographer are out of frame.
Pass Criteria:
1) Maintain the adult female face, round glasses, black shoulder-length bob with gray underneath.
2) Outfit, scene, main action, and accessories match, with natural fingers and contact.
3) The specified framing angle and complete composition are achieved.
4) An everyday smartphone photo with distance-dependent resolution falloff, natural skin tone shifts, and material differences.
5) Zero lateral head tilt. Face turned 35 degrees toward the friend in the driver's seat. Eyebrows slightly raised, lips parted slightly mid-sentence. An inquiring, lively expression without forcing a smile.

Maintain specified accessories.

Black shoulder-length straight bob with gray inner color only around the ears and lower layer. Upper layer of hair is black. Maintain round glasses. Opaque fabric.

Subject has exactly two arms and two hands. Hand-to-object contact and body support must appear natural. Strictly adhere to the expression and eye gaze for this scene. The character's signature smile and dimples are traits only when smiling, not a constant toothy grin.

Single AF point on the face. One standalone vertical 3:4 photo. Do not crop the head or limbs at the edges of the specified framing range; leave breathing room.
Only one image. Preserve the specified aspect ratio and full-frame composition requirements.

Natural shadows and exposure differences.

Only one AF plane. Do not perform face-only exposure compensation, relighting, skin smoothing, or restoration. Distant faces should retain broad tonal differences, nearby skin should retain irregular variations, and smartphone-specific processing artifacts should remain localized.

Depict only one clearly adult fictional woman as the sole subject in an unsplit single photograph. Exactly one head, one face, exactly two anatomically connected arms, and natural hand anatomy. Another person's hand in the foreground may only be added if explicitly specified in the scene or props, and that hand must remain clearly separate from her body. No text, panels, duplicate people, or alternate angles.
